derivations.claim: The generator assignment respects every defining relation, hence induces a graded homomorphism Φ, which is unique because the generators generate the presentation.
Every element of the PBW basis is the image of a product of generators and dots, so Φ is surjective.
The relations reduce every element to normal forms, and their images under the surjection are linearly independent by the PBW basis, so Φ is injective.
The corner identification and the product-compatibility theorem identify the shifted composition product with geometric convolution and give the degree dictionary d_η+d_ν−n.
Conclusion: Φ is the unique graded algebra isomorphism sending the intrinsic generators to the diagonal, Chern and normalized elementary classes.
